turns.replyText:
My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
If your tracking indicates delivered but you did not receive the package, please follow these steps:
Check around the delivery location
Inspect doors, side entrances, mailrooms, reception desks, parcel lockers, or other safe-drop locations.
Confirm with neighbors or anyone at the address who may have accepted the package.
Review the tracking details closely
Occasionally, the carrier marks a package as delivered shortly before it physically arrives.
It may be helpful to wait a little longer and monitor carrier updates.
Use your tracking link
The tracking link is typically included in the shipping confirmation email sent when the order shipped.
If you are signed in, the system may also be able to look up your latest order status and tracking details in the next message.
If the package still does not appear
Please indicate whether this was a home address, business address, or apartment/mailroom delivery, and specify how long ago it was marked delivered.
With this information, I can assist in determining the next best step.
If you would like, in your next message I can assist you in checking your latest order status or tracking through the system if you are signed in.
